show: Crash Dummies Podcast with Pat and Mike

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst art19.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts; nach 4 Tagen in der Cloud transkribiert, statt weiter auf den Rechner zu warten - das Modell schaetzt Zeitangaben, statt sie zu messen

einzeiler: The hosts discuss social etiquette, weird dating experiences, and fan interactions.
kurzfassung: The hosts debate wedding costs, share bizarre listener stories about exes and awkward encounters, and discuss public awkwardness and modern dating trends. They also tease upcoming live shows and interact with several callers. Finally, they wrap up with banter about personal habits and podcast updates.
stichpunkte: Discussion on the rising costs and social expectations of attending weddings
Callers share wild stories about exes, breakups, and unusual dates
Debate over whether a music venue in Milwaukee was justified in its playlist controversy
Reflecting on past podcast episodes and the evolution of the hosts' on-air dynamics
Interactions with live callers sharing personal anecdotes and relationship dilemmas
Teasing upcoming live shows including stops in New York, DC, Boston, and Houston
Sponsorship messages for ZocDoc and EarNin seamlessly integrated into the episode
